run_pre_release: run the pre-release version bump workflow by executing release.py with argparse
run_post_release: run the post-release version bump to dev by executing release.py with --post_release
run_patch_release: run a patch version bump by executing release.py with the --patch flag
update_version_in_file: update the version string in a single file like setup.py using a regex pattern
get_version: read and parse the current package version from the __init__ file
